evidence: TiN ﬁlm properties like thickness, mass density and surface roughness were studied by using X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) measurements. Contact mode atomic force microscopy was used to study the surface morphology of the samples. Low temperature PL measurements were made by using a diode-pumped frequency doubled Nd:YVO4 laser emitting at 532 nm wavelength for excitation. The low temperature time-resolved photoluminescence (TRPL) measurements were performed by exciting the samples with 150 fs pulses at 780 nm from a mode locked Ti:Sapphire laser. High resolution X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were carried out.
